device.description: 8-bit serial I/O SAR ADC with 2-channel multiplexer (single-ended or differential, 3-V, ADC0832 functional equivalent)
device.note: tlv0832.pdf (SLAS148) p.1 pinouts (D/P packages), p.3 functional description (CS, MUX settling clock, start bit, DI disabled during conversion, LSB-first data on TLV0832), p.4 sequence of operation and MUX-address control logic table, p.5 recommended operating conditions, p.7 operating characteristics (tpd, tdis, tconv)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the last MUX address after the start bit (p.4 MUX-address control logic table); not readable, cleared when CS goes high (p.3), reset 0 here

commands.name: Start bit + MUX address
commands.note: p.3-4: start bit (first 1 on DI), SGL/DIF, ODD/EVEN on CLK rising edges 1-3. ODD/EVEN 0 selects CH0 as the + input (or the single-ended channel), 1 selects CH1. Reply from falling edge 3: the MUX-settling low, D7..D0 MSB first, then D1..D7 LSB first (D0 shared), then DO low until CS rises

commands.name: Leading zero (no start bit)
commands.note: p.3: the first logic high on DI is the start bit; leading zeros are ignored

pages: p.1 (pinouts), p.3 (functional description), p.4 (sequence of operation, MUX-address table), p.5 (recommended operating conditions), p.7 (operating characteristics)
notModeled: single-ended / differential selection and polarity are stored only (CTRL.SGL_DIF); the result is the 0 V code

DI is disabled for the rest of the conversion after the MUX address (p.3); the model's stream frame keeps decoding DI, so a 1 on DI during the output restarts the reply. Hold DI low after the address; the DI/DO single-wire tie (p.3) is not supported
DO is Hi-Z from CS fall until the MUX-settling clock; the model shifts z for at most 32 leading clocks before a start bit
VCC/REF: the supply is also the reference (REF tied internally)
analog input(s) and the REF span (the result is always the 0 V code 0x00); a negative differential input reads 0x00
the conversion is clocked by CLK (8 clock periods after the MUX settling clock, p.7 tconv); not timed, the result is the 0 V code at once
all internal registers are cleared when CS goes high; a new conversion needs a CS high-to-low transition (p.3)
f(CLK) 10-600 kHz at VCC = 3.3 V, 250 kHz max at VCC = 2.7 V, 40-60 % duty cycle, tsu 350 ns / th 90 ns, CS high 220 ns min (p.5)
tpd (output data after CLK) is 500 ns max MSB-first and 200 ns max LSB-first at CL = 100 pF (p.7); the model uses 500 ns for every bit
tdis (CS high to DO Z) is 125 ns max at CL = 10 pF and 250 ns at CL = 100 pF (p.7); the model uses 250 ns
variants: TLV0831 (same datasheet): single differential input IN+/IN-, separate REF pin, no DI; separate device TLV0831. 3-V version of the TLC0832 (same pinout and protocol).
